projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Roads 2027-2034 (Work Plan Roadways)
projects.notes: Everything in the layer is planned (8-year construction work plan, federal fiscal years 2027-2037 in PROGRAM_FED_YR). No status field; T_LET_DATE_YEAR/T_LET_DATE_MONTH exist but were null in the sample, so PROGRAM_FED_YR is the schedule. Work codes 86:RIGHT OF WAY and 91:UTILITIES are separate job pieces that mark right-of-way acquisition. County is a number (COUNTY_NO), not a name. ODOT republishes under a new service name each October (..._2026to2033, ..._2027to2034).

projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Bridges 2027-2034 (Work Plan Bridges)
projects.notes: Bridges in the same 8-year plan; WORK_CODE uses the same numeric codes as the roads layer (text is in the roads layer's T_PROJ_WORK_DESC). PROG_FED_YR 2027-2037.

Canadian County Assessor 'Canadian County Parcel Data (Public)', edited 2026-11-13. SPATIAL QUERY CAVEAT: a point query with distance=200 fails ('24204: The spatial reference identifier (SRID) is not valid'; the layer is in State Plane, wkid 103133) but an envelope query works: geometry=<xmin>,<ymin>,<xmax>,<ymax>&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326 returned 138 parcels in El Reno. Terms read (item licence, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=7bbc6322290241a891f237dc43ed16bd): 'This data was created and assembled by the Canadian County Assessor's Office for your informational, planning reference and guidance only ... Canadian County makes no warranty, express or implied'; no commercial or solicitation limit stated. account is the assessor account number; parcel_size is in the unit named by parcel_size_units (Acres or Lots); land_val, bldg_val, total_assess, taxable_val also present.

STALE: 'Cleveland County Ownership Parcels Current as of October 2023', published by the City of Norman GIS account (GIS_normanok), not by the county assessor; last edited 2023-11-04. OWNER2, OWNER3; GEONUMBER second key; OWNER_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_SALE_DATE as text. No value field. Norman's current parcel layer (.../Parcels/FeatureServer/1, 46,482 rows) has no owner fields. No Cleveland County Assessor service found.

City of Lawton GIS (account gis.admin_colgis) service for its permitting system, layer 'PARCELS'; item text says 'UPDATED: 09/14/2026 parcel and owner information'. Owner name only: NO mailing address on the polygons, and the address fields were empty in the rows sampled. CAMAKey links to the assessor. The same service has table 15 'owner_info.csv' (48,609 rows: Account, ParcelID, Asmnt_Parcel_OwnersName, MailingInfo, Address1, Address2, City, State, ZipCode, TotalAcres) which carries the mailing address and can be joined on ParcelID, but a table takes no spatial query and its date is unknown (a sibling table is named Assessor_data_20221102). Layer 8 'Parcels (Lawton)' (35,284 rows, CAMADate Sept 2022) adds AssesValue / TotalValue. Coverage of the whole county not confirmed.

Rogers County Assessor data served by INCOG; description says 'It was last updated July 2023'. Owner name only: NO mailing address and no value fields. CADASTRAL is the map parcel number; LOTSIZE is text.

Wagoner County Assessor data served by INCOG; description says 'It was last updated July 2023'. ACCOUNT is the assessor account; MAILINFO is a care-of line; LOTSIZE is in the unit named by LOTSIZET; LANDV, IMPRV, TAXABLEV also present.

Creek County Assessor data served by INCOG; description says 'It was last updated July 2023' (a sale dated 10/10/2023 was seen). account is the assessor account; landvalue, imprvalue, taxable, saledate, saleprice also present.

parcels_counties.notes: Osage County Assessor data served by INCOG (Tulsa regional council of governments) on its own ArcGIS Server. MailingAdd holds the whole mailing address on one line. No acreage field. county_id = county number + ParcelId; CAMAKey is the assessor account key; AssesValue, ImpValue, LandValue also present; DataProv 'DataScout OneMap'. maxRecordCount 2000.

summary: Projects: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan road lines and bridge points (FFY 2027-2037) verified, all planned work with cost and program year. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; only Tulsa County verified, Oklahoma County and the others not found.
parcels_second_pass: Second pass 2026-11-17 (parcels only). Statewide / multi-county: no statewide owner layer found. INCOG (Tulsa regional council) serves assessor parcels for five counties from map11.incog.org: Tulsa (already on file), Creek, Rogers, Wagoner (added) and also Osage (https://map11.incog.org/arcgis11wa/rest/services/Parcels_OsageCo/FeatureServer/0, 42,072 rows, OwnerName plus MailingAdd / MailingCty / MailingSt / MailingZip, PubDate Sept 2026, spatial query works; not requested, so not added to the list). The Lawton and Osage layers share a schema (ParcelId, OwnerName, CAMAProv, PubDate, NatCooSys) that looks like a statewide standard, and an ArcGIS Online item 'Parcels (OWRB)' at https://maps.owrb.ok.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Hazard/Parcels/MapServer, registered by account okdot_gis_statewide, may be a statewide parcel service: it timed out on three attempts and is NOT verified. Worth one retry from another network. Oklahoma, Cleveland and Payne are covered only by old snapshots (2021, 2023, 2016) republished by cities. INCOG publishes no terms on the services; no INCOG data-terms page was found.
